# Astro SEO Toolkit

> Zero-dependency SEO helpers for Astro and static sites: llms.txt generator, JSON-LD schema builders, IndexNow submitter, sitemap and robots.txt generators. Tested, no installs, Node 18+.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/RelayStack/astro-seo-toolkit#readme): overview, quick start, Astro wiring
- [Tool reference](https://github.com/RelayStack/astro-seo-toolkit/tree/main/seo-toolkit): flags and API for every helper
- [GEO checklist](https://github.com/RelayStack/astro-seo-toolkit/blob/main/notes/geo-checklist.md): 2026 AI-search checklist for local business sites
- [Cloudflare Worker example](https://github.com/RelayStack/astro-seo-toolkit/blob/main/examples/cloudflare-worker-hello.js): minimal JSON + health-check worker
